supersedes.reason: Independent review demonstrated three semantic-validation bypasses in the first-pass identity, dependency, and approved-review claims. This manifest records the corrected implementation and regression evidence without rewriting the historical submission.

checks.result: The exact fix commit passed repository, runtime, architecture, agent-protocol, ADR, CI, formatting, lint, typing, packaging, 54 foundation tests, and canonical backlog checks.
The corrected validator accepted 20 capabilities, 117 slices, 356 tasks, and 12 release gates.
All ten focused tests pass, including direct denials for missing slice dependency targets, out-of-parent slice and task IDs, and DONE reviews without reviewer/timestamp metadata.

evidence: Slice-level depends_on values now resolve strictly to existing task IDs and produce a diagnostic naming both the owning slice and missing target.
Semantic validation now rejects slice IDs outside their containing capability namespace and task IDs outside their containing slice namespace.
DONE tasks now require evidence plus an approved review with a non-empty reviewer and reviewed_at timestamp; the original structural and task dependency/cycle diagnostics remain intact.
Four reviewer-derived mutation tests reproduce and deny every requested bypass, increasing the focused backlog suite from six to ten tests.
The complete foundation suite increased from 50 to 54 tests and passes at the exact fix commit.
planning/README.md now documents parent-namespace, slice-dependency, and complete-review invariants precisely.
The fix is confined to backlog semantic validation, its focused tests, and its documentation; the immutable first-pass evidence and changes-requested review record preserve the audit trail.
